welcome.title: Welcome to Nexta ERP
welcome.description: Nexta helps you manage sales, inventory, purchasing, finance and quotations in one intelligent workspace.
welcome.overviewText: A unified system to run your entire business operation smoothly.
welcome.unifiedText: Connect every department and stop jumping between disconnected tools.
welcome.aiPoweredText: Intelligent insights that help you make better decisions faster.
welcome.aiContext: Nexta AI acts as your virtual business analyst, processing your real-time data.

sales.title: Sales & CRM
sales.description: Sales tracks revenue, orders and customer activity to keep your business growing.
sales.revenueText: Monitor every dollar coming into your business with precise reporting.
sales.productText: Identify your best-selling items and your underperforming stock.
sales.trendsText: Visualize growth patterns and seasonal fluctuations automatically.
sales.aiContext: Nexta AI uses sales reports to identify growth opportunities and predict future sales patterns.

inventory.title: Master Data & Inventory
inventory.description: Inventory helps monitor stock levels and product availability across your warehouse.
inventory.liveStockText: Know exactly what you have on hand at any moment, updated in real-time.
inventory.lowStockText: Get notified before you run out, ensuring you never miss a sale.
inventory.turnoverText: Track how fast your inventory moves and optimize your storage space.
inventory.aiContext: Better inventory data leads to more accurate stock recommendations and replenishment alerts.

purchasing.title: Procurement & Purchasing
purchasing.description: Purchasing tracks supplier spending and procurement activity to optimize your costs.
purchasing.supplierText: Evaluate your vendors based on reliability, pricing, and delivery speed.
purchasing.poText: Create and track professional POs from draft to delivery confirmation.
purchasing.spendingText: Analyze where your money goes and identify cost-saving opportunities.
purchasing.aiContext: Nexta analyzes purchasing behavior and spending efficiency to improve your profit margins.

finance.title: Financial Intelligence
finance.description: Financial reports summarize business health through automated statements and P&L.
finance.cashFlowText: Monitor the movement of money in and out of your business clearly.
finance.profitabilityText: See your true net profit after accounting for all expenses and refunds.
finance.revenueAnalyticsText: Deep dive into your income sources and financial performance trends.
finance.aiContext: Financial insights depend on accurate records. The cleaner your data, the better the AI's advice.

devis.title: Quotations / Devis
devis.description: Devis manage your quotation pipeline and help convert leads into loyal customers.
devis.pipelineText: Track quotations from draft to sent, accepted, or rejected status.
devis.autoConversionText: Accepted devis are automatically converted into sales orders instantly.
devis.opportunityText: Identify why deals are lost and focus on the highest probability leads.
devis.aiContext: Nexta detects quotation performance and identifies untapped revenue opportunities in your pipeline.

data.title: Help Nexta Understand
data.description: Nexta AI does NOT invent information. It is a powerful engine that analyzes your actual business activity.
data.realDataText: The AI studies your ERP reports to find patterns you might miss.
data.accuracyText: Add products, track stock, and record every sale for best results.
data.dataDrivenText: AI quality depends directly on the completeness of your business data.
data.aiContext: The more complete your ERP data is, the more accurate and useful the AI analysis becomes.

ready.title: You're Ready!
ready.description: You now understand how Nexta works and how AI generates business insights from your data.
ready.exploreText: The dashboard is now yours to command. Welcome aboard!
ready.aiWaitingText: As you add data, the AI will start providing deeper insights.
ready.supportText: Our team is always here if you need help navigating the platform.
ready.aiContext: Ready to transform your business data into actionable intelligence?
